reason: The plan's index selection (instancePlanIndices: the rows read once into the indexes they record, the surge pairs in flight and the rank of every row, then the count filled) and the whole plan (BuildPlan) over a Component at 1,000 and 4,000 single-pod Instances, 160 gangs of eight and 1,725 gangs of two: at rest, at a scale-up with a quarter of the count still to add, with one Instance in ten mid gang surge and its replacement row claimed, with those pairs failed, and with those pairs promoted and the source retiring. Re-recorded with the selection reading its rows in place: it keeps where each index's row sits instead of a copy of every row, reads the failed gang surge sources once instead of four times and looks their replacement rows up by position instead of a map of every row, builds the set of recorded indexes once, and skips the set of taken indexes when the count is already filled. At rest at 1000x1 / 4000x1 / 160x8 / 1725x2 the selection costs 1,114 / 4,276 / 233 / 1,839 → 28 / 64 / 22 / 28 allocations and 556 KB / 2.22 MB / 79 KB / 701 KB → 102 KB / 405 KB / 14 KB / 107 KB; at the scale-up 841 / 3,187 / 194 / 1,408 → 31 / 67 / 26 / 34 and 352 KB / 1.40 MB / 72 KB / 623 KB → 87 KB / 342 KB / 17 KB / 131 KB; with the pairs in flight 1,277 / 4,763 / 288 / 2,138 → 90 / 150 / 60 / 114 and 598 KB / 2.39 MB / 87 KB / 1.12 MB → 124 KB / 495 KB / 19 KB / 246 KB; failed 1,284 / 4,774 / 291 / 2,147 → 69 / 121 / 47 / 89 and 596 KB / 2.38 MB / 86 KB / 1.11 MB → 115 KB / 457 KB / 17 KB / 226 KB; retiring 1,287 / 4,777 / 294 / 2,141 → 100 / 164 / 66 / 126 and 600 KB / 2.40 MB / 88 KB / 1.10 MB → 127 KB / 505 KB / 20 KB / 250 KB. The whole plan at rest costs 1,125 / 4,299 / 242 / 1,850 → 39 / 87 / 31 / 39 allocations and 691 KB / 2.75 MB / 100 KB / 910 KB → 237 KB / 938 KB / 35 KB / 316 KB, what remains being the plan's rows, the index of the observed rows and the selection's maps of positions, ranks and chosen indexes, which a map of 4,000 entries allocates in several tables.
